name: Cisco ASA — SMB Lateral Movement to Previously Unseen Internal Hosts
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = cisco_asa_raw
| filter cisco_asa_raw._raw_log contains "302014" and xdm.target.port = 445
| filter xdm.source.interface = "inside" and xdm.target.interface = "inside"
| filter to_integer(xdm.source.sent_bytes) >= 10000
| alter scanner_ip = xdm.source.ipv4
| comp count_distinct(xdm.target.ipv4) as smb_hosts,
       values(xdm.target.ipv4) as smb_targets
       by scanner_ip
| filter smb_hosts >= 5
| join type = left (
    dataset = cisco_asa_raw
    | filter _raw_log contains "722051" and _raw_log contains "assigned to session"
    | alter pool_ip = arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "Address <(\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)>"), 0),
            vpn_user = arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "User <([^>]+)>"), 0)
    | filter pool_ip != null
    | comp values(vpn_user) as vpn_user by pool_ip
    | fields pool_ip, vpn_user
  ) as vbind vbind.pool_ip = scanner_ip
| alter user_name = arrayindex(vpn_user, 0)
| fields scanner_ip, smb_targets, smb_hosts, user_name
description: Internal host establishing SMB/445 connections to 5–9 distinct internal hosts within 15 minutes — lateral movement after VPN compromise.
alert_name: Cisco ASA — SMB Lateral Movement to Previously Unseen Internal Hosts
alert_description:
What fired: Internal host establishing SMB/445 connections to 5–9 distinct internal hosts within 15 minutes — lateral movement after VPN compromise.

Why it matters: an actor is pivoting from one host to others inside the network. Assessed severity: High.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1021.002 - Remote Services: SMB/Windows Admin Shares (TA0008 - Lateral Movement).

Investigate:
  - Map the source host, the internal targets reached, and the account used.
  - Check for preceding credential access on the source and for new logons/sessions on the targets.
  - Pivot on the alert's key entity (xdm.target.ipv4) to related activity in the same window.
  - Confirm the activity is not expected/authorized for the involved entity before escalating.

TA0008 - Lateral Movement: T1021.002 - Remote Services: SMB/Windows Admin Shares
